suggestions.title: Postdoctoral Researchers (Junior / Senior) in LLMs, NLP, Knowledge Graphs and Graph Machine Learning
suggestions.institution: TU Dresden – ScaDS.AI (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and AI)

suggestions.why: Covers your LLM, knowledge-graph and GNN work at once, in a data-centric AI centre. Your SENTI and GNN-fairness work fit well.

suggestions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Tabular Foundation Models for Building and District Energy Systems
suggestions.institution: Empa – Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology
suggestions.procedure: Build and benchmark tabular foundation models for building and district energy data, transfer across systems and tasks, validate with measurements and simulations. Requires a PhD with a strong ML background and Python. Posted 18 Sep 2026. Apply via Empa's online job portal (confirm on the ad).
suggestions.keywords: tabular foundation models, machine learning, energy systems
suggestions.why: Foundation models for tabular/structured data is very close to your transformer-based imputation of relational data; energy domain also links to your Green AI interest.

suggestions.title: Postdoc in Sustainable Generative Artificial Intelligence for Media
suggestions.institution: KTH Royal Institute of Technology – School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
suggestions.procedure: HCI/ML postdoc on frugal GenAI for media: open-source small-data models, sustainability metrics, energy tracking and offensive-content monitoring for online broadcasting. Apply through KTH's Varbi portal before 5 Nov 2026 (Stockholm time).
suggestions.keywords: generative AI, sustainability, energy tracking, small-data models
suggestions.why: Matches your Green AI work (energy and carbon tracking with CodeCarbon) and LLM experience; the media/HCI angle is further from your data-quality focus.

suggestions.title: Multiple Postdoc Positions (Trustworthy ML, Transfer Learning, Theory and Algorithms)
suggestions.institution: ISTA – Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ELLIS Unit Vienna)
suggestions.group: Machine Learning and Computer Vision Group
suggestions.procedure: Send a single PDF to chl@ist.ac.at with: CV, research statement, list of publications, academic transcripts, and contact details of three references. 100% research, no teaching. Deadline 31/12/2026 per the ELLIS listing.
suggestions.keywords: trustworthy ML, fairness, privacy, robustness, LLM security, transfer/continual learning, symbolic AI + ML
suggestions.why: Trustworthy ML with fairness and robustness plus the symbolic-AI/logic + ML interface matches your fairness-aware imputation and logic-based data management work; a strong publication record is expected.

suggestions.title: Incarico di Ricerca: Entity Resolution Spiegabile con LLM (Explainable Entity Resolution with LLMs)
suggestions.institution: Università di Modena e Reggio Emilia (UNIMORE) – Dipartimento di Ingegneria "Enzo Ferrari"
suggestions.procedure: Research assignment (art. 22-ter L. 240/2010), selection by titles only, GSD 09/IINF-05. Develop explainable-AI methods for LLM-based entity resolution: attribution models for records, their interactions and semantic information in clustering decisions; evaluate fidelity, interpretability, efficiency and scalability. Apply only via PICA. Deadline not confirmed (the call PDF could not be opened; one search summary gave a date that conflicts with the Oct 2026 publication), so check the PDF. Also check eligibility, because 22-ter research assignments are a junior contract type.
suggestions.keywords: entity resolution, large language models, explainable AI, attribution, clustering
suggestions.why: Entity resolution with LLMs plus explainability is exactly your core area (LM-based data management, ER, trustworthy AI), in your own IINF-05 sector in Italy.

suggestions.title: Incarico post-doc: Progettazione e sviluppo di tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale e simulazione per l'analisi sicura e affidabile di sistemi complessi
suggestions.procedure: Incarico post-doc, 12 months. Applications opened 28 Sep 2026 09:00 and close 9 Oct 2026 12:00 via PICA (Salerno). Open the call on PICA for the sector, requirements and documents.
suggestions.keywords: artificial intelligence, simulation, safety, reliability, complex systems
suggestions.why: An Italian AI postdoc on safe and reliable AI fits your trustworthy-AI interests, but it is about simulation of complex systems rather than data quality or LLMs. The deadline is very soon.

suggestions.title: Postdoctoral Research Assistant in Machine Learning (agentic AI safety, security and control)
suggestions.institution: University of Oxford – Department of Engineering Science
suggestions.procedure: Online applications only, received before midday (UK) on 9 Oct 2026. Research on safety, security and control of agentic LLM systems (prompt injection, agent hijacking, adversarial robustness). Requires a PhD in CS/AI/Security and experience with LLMs or agents. Informal enquiries: adel.bibi@eng.ox.ac.uk.
suggestions.keywords: LLM agents, AI safety, adversarial robustness, prompt injection, AI security
suggestions.why: Uses your LLM experience and your secondary AI-for-cybersecurity interest. The focus is on attacks and safety rather than data quality. The deadline is very soon.

suggestions.title: Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellowship (Round 5)
suggestions.procedure: Up to 13 two-year fellowships to apply AI/ML to STEM research. Submit via IRAMS by 12:00 noon, 16 Oct 2026. Covers salary, research and travel costs, computing equipment and visa/NHS surcharge, plus AI/ML training and software-engineering support. See the How to apply page for the proposal and host requirements.
suggestions.keywords: AI for science, machine learning, fellowship
suggestions.why: A prestigious independent fellowship for early-career AI researchers. You would need to frame your data-quality and LLM methods around a STEM application and find an Oxford host quickly.

suggestions.keywords: NLP, LLMs, speech recognition, education, health
